arguments.key: Decisions: O2 relist and O4 next step
arguments.value:
(1) Do NOT relist the O2 dog-groomer sheet at £12 for 21 days unchanged. It was already £12 for 21 days: 212 views, 0 sales (SIMULATED). The objections (MTD, free accountant sheet) are structural, so a repeat gives no new information. Ceiling £0. Reconsider only with a changed offer plus evidence that there is a segment exempt from MTD.
(2) O4: do only the three free desk checks: (a) the best seller's 9 reviews; (b) official MTD thresholds; (c) confirm the Stallhub fee at £6. Cap £0 cash plus about £1 of AI usage, within 7 days. Kill if the reviews show no mobile-specific gap, if most of the target must use MTD from April 2027, or if the checks can't be completed. A £6 sale nets about £5.02 on the fees effective 1 Oct 2026. Listing (£0.20) only after all three pass and the spend is approved.
